text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus discusses the future with 
Ines Fujin, Mejiro McQueen, and Mejiro 
Ryan. They are all members of her 
generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While Ikuno Dictus chooses to pursue the 
Triple Tiara route, the other three plan 
to aim for the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if she took a different route, as 
long as she kept running, they might 
compete in the Senior year. Expectations 
for the future grew.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, the Trainer worries about the 
steep road ahead due to the many 
formidable rivals in her generation. 
However, Ikuno Dictus remains positive.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fighting against formidable rivals would 
improve both the quantity and quality of 
experience gained. With that in mind, her 
fighting spirit burned for her debut race.
